findings.value: A trattoria in a converted Victorian pub on Columbia Road, run by chef Dara Klein with regional Italian dishes.

evidence.quote: inside a gorgeously gabled Victorian boozer on the eastern fringes of Colombia Road
Dipping into rarer regional cracks of Italian cuisine

findings.value: Time Out sees it as a local hub where people gather over food and drink.

evidence.quote: a welcoming hub where the community comes together over food and booze
